cosaSono.testo: Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They are used to improve the browsing experience and to ensure that certain features work.

terzeParti.testo: GymMaster does not use profiling, tracking or third-party cookies. We do not use Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel or other tracking services.

gestione.intro: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time:
gestione.banner: Through the cookie banner in the application
gestione.cancellazione: By deleting the cookies stored by the browser
gestione.nota: Note: disabling necessary cookies may impair the operation of the application (for example, it will not be possible to keep the login session active).

baseGiuridica.testo: Strictly necessary cookies are processed on the basis of legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). For any non-essential cookies, the user's explicit consent will be requested (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
